changes.summary: DHS issued an interim final HAVANA Act rule establishing eligibility, payment amounts, procedures and appeals for covered employees and dependents; it takes effect December 21 and payments remain contingent on appropriations.

The FDIC proposed rules for the new statutory custodial-deposit exception, including a 20 percent cap, notice and certification duties, and interest-rate restrictions; comments remain open through January 19.

evidence_extracts.dhs_havana_act: The published interim final rule sets 2026 base and base-plus payments at $157,200 and $209,600, respectively, but makes awards discretionary, contingent on specifically appropriated funds and effective December 21, 2026.
evidence_extracts.fdic_custodial_deposits: The proposal estimates 4,031 institutions could meet its eligibility definition and as many as 1,629 could be immediately affected if finalized; it is not a final rule.
